title: Property of Zanner Toobin

sources.title: Disable the Steel Watch
markers: one final way to obtain the code

summary: Read with The Many Faces of Gond to disable the Steel Watch without Toobin.

fields.Read: This book points to Gond’s true name. Read The Many Faces of Gond in the nearby surgery-area bookcase to learn Nebelun and use it at the Neurocitor. This route works if Toobin’s body cannot be questioned with Speak with Dead.
fields.Acquisition: Carried by Zanner Toobin. Combat can destroy the separate bookcase before you retrieve its book.

changes: Added native BG3 rules using pinned item and linked gameplay sources.
